 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Showbiz Showbiz Nicole Fortuna, Cianne Dominguez evicted from 'Pinoy Big Brother: Collab Edition 3.0' 
 By GMA News Published November 21, 2026 7:08pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Photo: PBB Nicole Fortuna and Cianne Dominguez have been evicted from “Pinoy Big Brother: Collab Edition 3.0.”
 Saturday’s episode showed that Nicole and Cianne got the lowest percentage of votes to save with 23.92% and 3.98% respectively.
 The other nominees, Primo Alterado, Nathan Garcia, Raheel Bhyria, and Bela Arcal, were safe from this week’s eviction.
 During the second nominations, Raheel lead the nominees with eight points for the Kapuso housemates, while Bela and Nicole got five points and two points respectively.

 On the Kapamilya side, Primo received the highest number of points with 12 while Cianne and Nathan got two points each.
 Meanwhile, Lans Nagal and Jeo Ong were safe from nominations after winning the Ligtask Challenge.
 The first housemates who got eliminated were Ethan Benares and Calix Esguerra . They were evicted last Saturday.
 Meanwhile, Allen Ansay , Ronnie Pasamba, Daniela Stranner , Lorelaine Sañosa entered PBB as the newest addition to the housemates.
 "PBB: Collab 3.0" premiered on October 24. The reality series airs on GMA Network from Mondays to Fridays at 9:35 p.m., Saturdays at 6:15 p.m., and Sundays at 4:55 p.m. —Jade Veronique Yap/JCB, GMA News
